description: DiligenceOps: submit an accessibility statement or conformance claim. The signed report marks the standard and level claimed (WCAG version and A, AA or AAA, Section 508, EN 301 549), the date of the claim, the evaluation method, known limitations and a feedback contact present, missing or ambiguous, with quotes, and flags full conformance claimed beside known limitations, a claim with no method and a claim dated more than a year before the check. POST /api/accessibility-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-disclosure-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the statement, recorded in the report.

statement.description: The accessibility statement or conformance claim, up to 256 KB.
